## Navigation Menu (`navigation-menu`)

Navigation Menu built on Base UI.

- Type: `registry:ui`
- Install: `npx @ternetin/ui add navigation-menu`
- npm dependencies: `@base-ui/react@^1.9.0`
- Registry dependencies: `utils`, `motion`

### `src/ui/navigation-menu.tsx`

````tsx
'use client';
import { NavigationMenu as BaseNavigationMenu } from '@base-ui/react/navigation-menu';
import type * as React from 'react';
import { useMotionPopupRender } from '@/lib/motion';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';
export function NavigationMenu({
  className,
  children,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<typeof BaseNavigationMenu.Root>) {
  const renderPopup = useMotionPopupRender({ scale: 0.98, offset: 6 });
  return (
    <BaseNavigationMenu.Root className={cn('relative', className)} {...props}>
      {children}
      <BaseNavigationMenu.Portal>
        <BaseNavigationMenu.Positioner className="z-50" sideOffset={8}>
          <BaseNavigationMenu.Popup
            className={cn(
              'border border-border bg-popover text-popover-foreground shadow-popup outline-none',
              // Base UI measures each panel and publishes the target box as CSS
              // variables (`auto` while a single panel is open, pixel values while
              // switching). Transitioning them is what makes the popup morph
              // between items of different sizes instead of snapping. Motion owns
              // opacity and transform for the enter/exit, so the two never contend
              // for the same properties.
              'h-[var(--popup-height)] w-[var(--popup-width)] overflow-hidden',
              'transition-[width,height] duration-200 ease-[cubic-bezier(0.32,0.72,0,1)] motion-reduce:transition-none',
              '[transform-origin:var(--transform-origin)]',
              'rounded-surface'
            )}
            render={renderPopup}
          >
            <BaseNavigationMenu.Viewport />
          </BaseNavigationMenu.Popup>
        </BaseNavigationMenu.Positioner>
      </BaseNavigationMenu.Portal>
    </BaseNavigationMenu.Root>
  );
}
export function NavigationMenuList({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<typeof BaseNavigationMenu.List>) {
  return <BaseNavigationMenu.List className={cn('flex items-center gap-1', className)} {...props} />;
}
export const NavigationMenuItem = BaseNavigationMenu.Item;
export function NavigationMenuTrigger({
  className,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<typeof BaseNavigationMenu.Trigger>) {
  return (
    <BaseNavigationMenu.Trigger
      className={cn(
        'px-3 py-2 text-sm font-medium tracking-[-0.01em] outline-none transition-colors hover:bg-accent hover:text-accent-foreground focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring',
        className
      )}
      {...props}
    />
  );
}
export function NavigationMenuContent({
  className,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<typeof BaseNavigationMenu.Content>) {
  return (
    <BaseNavigationMenu.Content
      className={cn(
        'w-max',
        // Panels cross-fade in the direction the user moved along the menu bar.
        'transition-[opacity,transform] duration-200 ease-[cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1)]',
        'data-[starting-style]:opacity-0 data-[ending-style]:opacity-0',
        'data-[activation-direction=left]:data-[starting-style]:-translate-x-1/4',
        'data-[activation-direction=right]:data-[starting-style]:translate-x-1/4',
        'data-[activation-direction=left]:data-[ending-style]:translate-x-1/4',
        'data-[activation-direction=right]:data-[ending-style]:-translate-x-1/4',
        className
      )}
      {...props}
    />
  );
}
export function NavigationMenuLink({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<typeof BaseNavigationMenu.Link>) {
  return (
    <BaseNavigationMenu.Link
      className={cn(
        'block px-3 py-2 text-sm leading-5 outline-none hover:bg-accent hover:text-accent-foreground focus-visible:bg-accent focus-visible:text-accent-foreground',
        className
      )}
      {...props}
    />
  );
}
````

- Type: `registry:ui`

- npm dependencies: `@base-ui/react@^1.9.0`
- Registry dependencies: `utils`

### `src/ui/otp-field.tsx`

````tsx
'use client';
import { OTPField as BaseOTPField } from '@base-ui/react/otp-field';
import type * as React from 'react';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';
export interface OtpFieldProps extends Omit<React.ComponentProps<typeof BaseOTPField.Root>, 'length'> {
  length?: number;
}
export function OtpField({ className, length = 6, ...props }: OtpFieldProps) {
  return (
    <BaseOTPField.Root length={length} className={cn('flex gap-2', className)} {...props}>
      {Array.from({ length }).map((_, i) => (
        <BaseOTPField.Input
          // biome-ignore lint/suspicious/noArrayIndexKey: fixed-length OTP cells
          key={i}
          className={cn(
            'size-11 border border-input bg-background text-center text-lg tabular-nums outline-none transition-colors focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring',
            'rounded-control'
          )}
        />
      ))}
    </BaseOTPField.Root>
  );
}
````

## Popover (`popover`)

Popover built on Base UI.

- Type: `registry:ui`
- Install: `npx @ternetin/ui add popover`
- npm dependencies: `@base-ui/react@^1.9.0`
- Registry dependencies: `utils`, `motion`

### `src/ui/popover.tsx`

````tsx
'use client';
import { Popover as BasePopover } from '@base-ui/react/popover';
import type * as React from 'react';
import { useMotionPopupRender } from '@/lib/motion';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';
export const Popover = BasePopover.Root;
export const PopoverTrigger = BasePopover.Trigger;
export const PopoverClose = BasePopover.Close;
export function PopoverContent({
  className,
  children,
  sideOffset = 8,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<typeof BasePopover.Popup> & {
  sideOffset?: number;
}) {
  const renderPopup = useMotionPopupRender();
  return (
    <BasePopover.Portal>
      <BasePopover.Positioner sideOffset={sideOffset} className="z-50">
        <BasePopover.Popup
          className={cn(
            'w-72 border border-border bg-popover p-3 text-popover-foreground outline-none',
            'shadow-popup',
            // Grow out of the anchor rather than the popup's own centre.
            '[transform-origin:var(--transform-origin)]',
            'rounded-surface',
            className
          )}
          render={renderPopup}
          {...props}
        >
          <BasePopover.Arrow
            className={cn(
              'size-2.5 rotate-45 border border-border bg-popover',
              'data-[side=top]:bottom-[-5px] data-[side=bottom]:top-[-5px]',
              'data-[side=left]:right-[-5px] data-[side=right]:left-[-5px]'
            )}
          />
          {children}
        </BasePopover.Popup>
      </BasePopover.Positioner>
    </BasePopover.Portal>
  );
}
export function PopoverTitle({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<typeof BasePopover.Title>) {
  return (
    <BasePopover.Title className={cn('text-sm font-semibold leading-none tracking-[-0.01em]', className)} {...props} />
  );
}
export function PopoverDescription({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<typeof BasePopover.Description>) {
  return <BasePopover.Description className={cn('text-sm leading-6 text-muted-foreground', className)} {...props} />;
}
````

````tsx
'use client';
import { PreviewCard as BasePreviewCard } from '@base-ui/react/preview-card';

  className,
  children,
  sideOffset = 8,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<typeof BasePreviewCard.Popup> & {
````

## Progress (`progress`)

Progress built on Base UI.

- Type: `registry:ui`
- Install: `npx @ternetin/ui add progress`
- npm dependencies: `@base-ui/react@^1.9.0`
- Registry dependencies: `utils`

### `src/ui/progress.tsx`

````tsx
'use client';
import { Progress as BaseProgress } from '@base-ui/react/progress';
import type * as React from 'react';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';
export function Progress({ className, children, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<typeof BaseProgress.Root>) {
  return (
    <BaseProgress.Root className={cn('flex w-full flex-col gap-1', className)} {...props}>
      <BaseProgress.Track
        className={cn('h-2 w-full overflow-hidden border border-border bg-secondary', 'rounded-full')}
      >
        {/*
          Width stays in CSS: Base UI writes the filled width as an inline style
          from the current value, and a transition on that property is what makes
          value changes glide instead of jumping. Motion would need to own the
          width to animate it, and it has no access to the value.
        */}
        <BaseProgress.Indicator
          className={cn(
            'h-full bg-primary',
            'transition-[width] duration-300 ease-[cubic-bezier(0.32,0.72,0,1)]',
            'data-[indeterminate]:w-1/3 data-[indeterminate]:animate-[progress-indeterminate_1.2s_ease-in-out_infinite]'
          )}
        />
      </BaseProgress.Track>
      {children}
    </BaseProgress.Root>
  );
}
export function ProgressLabel({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<typeof BaseProgress.Label>) {
  return (
    <BaseProgress.Label
      className={cn('text-xs font-medium uppercase tracking-[0.08em] text-muted-foreground', className)}
      {...props}
    />
  );
}
export function ProgressValue({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<typeof BaseProgress.Value>) {
  return <BaseProgress.Value className={cn('text-xs tabular-nums text-muted-foreground', className)} {...props} />;
}
````

## Radio Group (`radio-group`)

Radio Group built on Base UI.

- Type: `registry:ui`
- Install: `npx @ternetin/ui add radio-group`
- npm dependencies: `@base-ui/react@^1.9.0`, `motion@^12.43.0`
- Registry dependencies: `utils`, `motion`

### `src/ui/radio-group.tsx`

````tsx
'use client';
import { Radio as BaseRadio } from '@base-ui/react/radio';
import { RadioGroup as BaseRadioGroup } from '@base-ui/react/radio-group';
import { cva, type VariantProps } from 'class-variance-authority';
import { type HTMLMotionProps, motion } from 'motion/react';
import type * as React from 'react';
import { useControlTransition } from '@/lib/motion';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';

const radioGroupVariants = cva('flex gap-2', {
  variants: {
    orientation: {
      vertical: 'flex-col',
      horizontal: 'flex-row'
    }
  },
  defaultVariants: {
    orientation: 'vertical'
  }
});
export interface RadioGroupProps
  extends React.ComponentProps<typeof BaseRadioGroup>,
    VariantProps<typeof radioGroupVariants> {}
export function RadioGroup({ className, orientation, ...props }: RadioGroupProps) {
  return <BaseRadioGroup className={cn(radioGroupVariants({ orientation }), className)} {...props} />;
}
export function RadioGroupItem({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<typeof BaseRadio.Root>) {
  const transition = useControlTransition();
  return (
    <BaseRadio.Root
      className={cn(
        'flex size-5 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full border border-input bg-background outline-none transition-colors',
        'focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring',
        'data-[checked]:border-primary',
        'disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-40',
        className
      )}
      {...props}
    >
      {/* `keepMounted` so the dot can scale away as well as in — see checkbox.tsx. */}
      <BaseRadio.Indicator
        keepMounted
        className="size-2.5 rounded-full bg-primary"
        render={(indicatorProps, state) => (
          <motion.span
            {...(indicatorProps as HTMLMotionProps<'span'>)}
            initial={false}
            animate={{ opacity: state.checked ? 1 : 0, scale: state.checked ? 1 : 0 }}
            transition={transition}
          />
        )}
      />
    </BaseRadio.Root>
  );
}
export { radioGroupVariants };
````

## Scroll Area (`scroll-area`)

Scroll Area built on Base UI.

- Type: `registry:ui`
- Install: `npx @ternetin/ui add scroll-area`
- npm dependencies: `@base-ui/react@^1.9.0`
- Registry dependencies: `utils`

### `src/ui/scroll-area.tsx`

````tsx
'use client';
import { ScrollArea as BaseScrollArea } from '@base-ui/react/scroll-area';
import type * as React from 'react';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';
export function ScrollArea({ className, children, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<typeof BaseScrollArea.Root>) {
  return (
    <BaseScrollArea.Root className={cn('relative overflow-hidden', 'rounded-surface', className)} {...props}>
      <BaseScrollArea.Viewport className="size-full overscroll-contain outline-none">
        {children}
      </BaseScrollArea.Viewport>
      {/*
          Scrollbars rest invisible and fade in while the pointer is over the area
          or the user is scrolling. Base UI reports both as data attributes, so this
          is a CSS transition rather than Motion — there's no mount/unmount to
          coordinate, and it keeps the scroll path free of React work.
        */}
      <BaseScrollArea.Scrollbar
        orientation="vertical"
        className={cn(
          'flex w-2 touch-none select-none border-l border-border p-0.5',
          'opacity-0 transition-opacity duration-200 ease-out',
          'data-[hovering]:opacity-100 data-[scrolling]:opacity-100'
        )}
      >
        <BaseScrollArea.Thumb className="w-full bg-muted-foreground/60" />
      </BaseScrollArea.Scrollbar>
      <BaseScrollArea.Scrollbar
        orientation="horizontal"
        className={cn(
          'flex h-2 touch-none select-none border-t border-border p-0.5',
          'opacity-0 transition-opacity duration-200 ease-out',
          'data-[hovering]:opacity-100 data-[scrolling]:opacity-100'
        )}
      >
        <BaseScrollArea.Thumb className="h-full bg-muted-foreground/60" />
      </BaseScrollArea.Scrollbar>
      <BaseScrollArea.Corner />
    </BaseScrollArea.Root>
  );
}
````

## Select (`select`)

Select built on Base UI.

- Type: `registry:ui`
- Install: `npx @ternetin/ui add select`
- npm dependencies: `@base-ui/react@^1.9.0`
- Registry dependencies: `utils`, `motion`

### `src/ui/select.tsx`

````tsx
'use client';
import { Select as BaseSelect } from '@base-ui/react/select';
import type * as React from 'react';
import { useMotionPopupRender } from '@/lib/motion';
import { cn, NESTED_RADIUS } from '@/lib/utils';
export const Select = BaseSelect.Root;
export const SelectValue = BaseSelect.Value;
export function SelectTrigger({ className, children, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<typeof BaseSelect.Trigger>) {
  return (
    <BaseSelect.Trigger
      className={cn(
        'flex h-9 w-full items-center justify-between gap-2 border border-input bg-background px-3 py-2 text-sm leading-5 text-foreground outline-none',
        'focus-visible:border-ring focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring',
        'disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-40',
        'rounded-control',
        className
      )}
      {...props}
    >
      {children}
      <BaseSelect.Icon className="flex size-4 shrink-0 items-center justify-center text-muted-foreground">
        <svg
          viewBox="0 0 16 16"
          className="size-4"
          fill="none"
          stroke="currentColor"
          strokeWidth={2}
          aria-hidden="true"
        >
          <path d="M4 6l4 4 4-4" />
        </svg>
      </BaseSelect.Icon>
    </BaseSelect.Trigger>
  );
}
export function SelectContent({ className, children, style, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<typeof BaseSelect.Popup>) {
  // Unlike other popups, Select stays mounted after the first interaction. The
  // same open-state-driven animation covers both cases — the first open plays
  // `initial`, later ones animate between the two variants.
  const renderPopup = useMotionPopupRender();
  return (
    <BaseSelect.Portal>
      <BaseSelect.Positioner sideOffset={4} className="z-50">
        <BaseSelect.Popup
          // Nested items follow the fixed popup corner treatment.
          style={style}
          className={cn(
            'min-w-[var(--anchor-width)] border border-border bg-popover p-1 text-popover-foreground shadow-popup outline-none',
            '[transform-origin:var(--transform-origin)]',
            'rounded-surface',
            className
          )}
          render={renderPopup}
          {...props}
        >
          {children}
        </BaseSelect.Popup>
      </BaseSelect.Positioner>
    </BaseSelect.Portal>
  );
}
export function SelectItem({ className, children, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<typeof BaseSelect.Item>) {
  return (
    <BaseSelect.Item
      className={cn(
        'flex cursor-pointer items-center justify-between gap-2 px-3 py-1.5 text-sm leading-5 outline-none select-none',
        NESTED_RADIUS,
        'data-[highlighted]:bg-accent data-[highlighted]:text-accent-foreground',
        className
      )}
      {...props}
    >
      <BaseSelect.ItemText>{children}</BaseSelect.ItemText>
      <BaseSelect.ItemIndicator className="text-primary">
        <svg
          viewBox="0 0 16 16"
          className="size-3.5"
          fill="none"
          stroke="currentColor"
          strokeWidth={2.25}
          aria-hidden="true"
        >
          <path d="M3 8l3 3 7-7" />
        </svg>
      </BaseSelect.ItemIndicator>
    </BaseSelect.Item>
  );
}
````

## Slider (`slider`)

Slider built on Base UI.

- Type: `registry:ui`
- Install: `npx @ternetin/ui add slider`
- npm dependencies: `@base-ui/react@^1.9.0`, `motion@^12.43.0`
- Registry dependencies: `utils`, `motion`

### `src/ui/slider.tsx`

````tsx
'use client';
import { Slider as BaseSlider } from '@base-ui/react/slider';
import { type HTMLMotionProps, motion } from 'motion/react';
import type * as React from 'react';
import { useControlTransition } from '@/lib/motion';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';
export function Slider({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<typeof BaseSlider.Root>) {
  const transition = useControlTransition();
  return (
    <BaseSlider.Root className={cn('relative w-full', className)} {...props}>
      <BaseSlider.Control className="flex w-full items-center py-3">
        <BaseSlider.Track className={cn('h-1.5 w-full bg-border', 'rounded-full')}>
          <BaseSlider.Indicator className={cn('bg-primary', 'rounded-full')} />
          <BaseSlider.Thumb
            className={cn(
              'size-4 border border-primary bg-background outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring',
              'rounded-full'
            )}
            render={(thumbProps, state) => (
              <motion.div
                {...(thumbProps as HTMLMotionProps<'div'>)}
                // Grows under the finger while dragging. Base UI owns the thumb's
                // position, so only scale is animated here — no transform clash.
                initial={false}
                animate={{ scale: state.dragging ? 1.25 : 1 }}
                transition={transition}
              />
            )}
          />
        </BaseSlider.Track>
      </BaseSlider.Control>
    </BaseSlider.Root>
  );
}
export function SliderValue({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<typeof BaseSlider.Value>) {
  return <BaseSlider.Value className={cn('text-xs tabular-nums text-muted-foreground', className)} {...props} />;
}
````

## Switch (`switch`)

Switch built on Base UI.

- Type: `registry:ui`
- Install: `npx @ternetin/ui add switch`
- npm dependencies: `@base-ui/react@^1.9.0`, `motion@^12.43.0`
- Registry dependencies: `utils`, `motion`

### `src/ui/switch.tsx`

````tsx
'use client';
import { Switch as BaseSwitch } from '@base-ui/react/switch';
import { type HTMLMotionProps, motion } from 'motion/react';
import type * as React from 'react';
import { useControlTransition } from '@/lib/motion';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';

/** Thumb travel, in px, matching `h-6 w-11` track and `size-4` thumb. */
const THUMB_OFF = 4;
const THUMB_ON = 24;
export type SwitchProps = React.ComponentProps<typeof BaseSwitch.Root>;
export function Switch({ className, ...props }: SwitchProps) {
  const transition = useControlTransition();
  return (
    <BaseSwitch.Root
      className={cn(
        'relative inline-flex h-6 w-11 shrink-0 cursor-pointer items-center border border-input bg-background transition-colors outline-none',
        'focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring',
        'data-[checked]:border-primary data-[checked]:bg-primary',
        'disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-40',
        'rounded-full',
        className
      )}
      {...props}
    >
      <BaseSwitch.Thumb
        className={cn(
          'block size-4 bg-foreground transition-colors data-[checked]:bg-primary-foreground',
          'rounded-full'
        )}
        render={(thumbProps, state) => (
          <motion.span
            {...(thumbProps as HTMLMotionProps<'span'>)}
            // `initial={false}` so a switch that starts checked renders in place
            // instead of sliding across on first paint.
            initial={false}
            animate={{ x: state.checked ? THUMB_ON : THUMB_OFF }}
            transition={transition}
          />
        )}
      />
    </BaseSwitch.Root>
  );
}
````

## Tabs (`tabs`)

Tabs built on Base UI.

- Type: `registry:ui`
- Install: `npx @ternetin/ui add tabs`
- npm dependencies: `@base-ui/react@^1.9.0`, `motion@^12.43.0`
- Registry dependencies: `utils`, `motion`

### `src/ui/tabs.tsx`

````tsx
'use client';
import { Tabs as BaseTabs } from '@base-ui/react/tabs';
import { cva, type VariantProps } from 'class-variance-authority';
import { type HTMLMotionProps, motion } from 'motion/react';
import type * as React from 'react';
import { transitions, useControlTransition } from '@/lib/motion';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';
export const Tabs = BaseTabs.Root;
const tabsListVariants = cva('relative inline-flex items-center', {
  variants: {
    variant: {
      /** Bordered bar with a rule underneath the active tab. */
      default: 'gap-0 border border-border',
      /** Segmented control: a filled block slides between tabs. */
      muted: 'gap-1 bg-muted p-1',
      /** No chrome at all — just the tabs and the rule. */
      ghost: 'gap-1'
    }
  },
  defaultVariants: {
    variant: 'default'
  }
});
/**
 * The indicator is the same element in every variant, restyled — which is what
 * lets it animate between tabs. The `muted` variant grows it to a full-height
 * block behind the active tab instead of a rule beneath it.
 */
const tabsIndicatorVariants = cva('absolute left-0 z-0', {
  variants: {
    variant: {
      default: 'bottom-0 h-0.5 bg-primary',
      muted: 'inset-y-1 border border-primary/20 bg-background',
      ghost: 'bottom-0 h-0.5 bg-primary'
    }
  },
  defaultVariants: {
    variant: 'default'
  }
});
export type TabsVariant = NonNullable<VariantProps<typeof tabsListVariants>['variant']>;
export function TabsList({
  className,
  variant,
  children,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<typeof BaseTabs.List> & VariantProps<typeof tabsListVariants>) {
  return (
    <BaseTabs.List className={cn(tabsListVariants({ variant }), className)} {...props}>
      {children}
      <TabsIndicator variant={variant} />
    </BaseTabs.List>
  );
}
export function TabsIndicator({
  className,
  variant,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<typeof BaseTabs.Indicator> & VariantProps<typeof tabsIndicatorVariants>) {
  return (
    <BaseTabs.Indicator
      data-slot="tabs-indicator"
      className={cn(
        // Stays CSS rather than Motion: Base UI publishes the active tab's box as
        // CSS variables, and Motion can't re-run an animation when the value
        // behind a `var()` changes — the target string never changes. A CSS
        // transition re-reads the variable on every update, so it tracks properly.
        'w-[var(--active-tab-width)] translate-x-[var(--active-tab-left)]',
        'transition-[translate,width] duration-200 ease-[cubic-bezier(0.32,0.72,0,1)] motion-reduce:transition-none',
        tabsIndicatorVariants({ variant }),
        className
      )}
      {...props}
    />
  );
}
export function TabsTab({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<typeof BaseTabs.Tab>) {
  return (
    <BaseTabs.Tab
      className={cn(
        'relative z-10 cursor-pointer px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium tracking-[-0.01em] text-muted-foreground transition-colors outline-none',
        'hover:text-accent-foreground',
        'focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring focus-visible:ring-inset',
        'data-[active]:text-primary',
        'data-[disabled]:pointer-events-none data-[disabled]:opacity-40',
        className
      )}
      {...props}
    />
  );
}
export function TabsPanel({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<typeof BaseTabs.Panel>) {
  const transition = useControlTransition(transitions.enter);
  return (
    <BaseTabs.Panel
      className={cn('mt-4 outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring', className)}
      render={(panelProps, state) => (
        <motion.div
          {...(panelProps as HTMLMotionProps<'div'>)}
          // Panels are unmounted while inactive (Base UI's default), so the
          // incoming one mounts fresh and needs a real `initial` to fade from.
          // `initial={false}` would land it at full opacity with nothing to play.
          // The panel reports `hidden` rather than an open flag.
          initial={{ opacity: 0, y: -4 }}
          animate={{ opacity: state.hidden ? 0 : 1, y: state.hidden ? -4 : 0 }}
          transition={transition}
        />
      )}
      {...props}
    />
  );
}
export { tabsIndicatorVariants, tabsListVariants };
````

## Toast (`toast`)

Toast built on Base UI.

- Type: `registry:ui`
- Install: `npx @ternetin/ui add toast`
- npm dependencies: `@base-ui/react@^1.9.0`
- Registry dependencies: `utils`

### `src/ui/toast.tsx`

````tsx
'use client';
import { Toast as BaseToast } from '@base-ui/react/toast';
import { cva, type VariantProps } from 'class-variance-authority';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';
export const ToastProvider = BaseToast.Provider;
export const useToast = BaseToast.useToastManager;
const viewportVariants = cva('fixed z-50 flex outline-none', {
  variants: {
    position: {
      // Bottom stacks grow upward, so the newest toast stays nearest the edge.
      'bottom-right': 'bottom-4 right-4 flex-col-reverse gap-2',
      'bottom-left': 'bottom-4 left-4 flex-col-reverse gap-2',
      'bottom-center': 'bottom-4 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 flex-col-reverse gap-2 items-center',
      'top-right': 'top-4 right-4 flex-col gap-2',
      'top-left': 'top-4 left-4 flex-col gap-2',
      'top-center': 'top-4 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 flex-col gap-2 items-center'
    }
  },
  defaultVariants: {
    position: 'bottom-right'
  }
});
export type ToastPosition = NonNullable<VariantProps<typeof viewportVariants>['position']>;
/**
 * Which way a toast travels as it arrives and leaves — outward, toward whichever
 * edge it's anchored to.
 */
const enterFrom: Record<ToastPosition, string> = {
  'bottom-right': 'data-[starting-style]:[translate:100%_0] data-[ending-style]:[translate:100%_0]',
  'bottom-left': 'data-[starting-style]:[translate:-100%_0] data-[ending-style]:[translate:-100%_0]',
  'bottom-center': 'data-[starting-style]:[translate:0_100%] data-[ending-style]:[translate:0_100%]',
  'top-right': 'data-[starting-style]:[translate:100%_0] data-[ending-style]:[translate:100%_0]',
  'top-left': 'data-[starting-style]:[translate:-100%_0] data-[ending-style]:[translate:-100%_0]',
  'top-center': 'data-[starting-style]:[translate:0_-100%] data-[ending-style]:[translate:0_-100%]'
};
interface ToastListProps {
  position: ToastPosition;
}
function ToastList({ position }: ToastListProps) {
  const { toasts } = BaseToast.useToastManager();
  return toasts.map((toast) => (
    <BaseToast.Root
      key={toast.id}
      toast={toast}
      className={cn(
        'relative w-80 border border-border bg-background p-4 text-foreground',
        'shadow-popup',
        // Toast motion is CSS rather than Motion, and deliberately so: during a
        // swipe Base UI drives this element by writing `transform` directly, so a
        // `motion.div` — which owns `transform` — would stop the toast following
        // the finger. See lib/motion.tsx for where Motion is used.
        //
        // Enter and exit are ours, via `translate`, which Tailwind compiles to a
        // property separate from the `transform` Base UI writes. Don't add
        // `--toast-swipe-movement-*` here: Base UI already applies that movement,
        // and reapplying it would move the toast twice as far as the finger.
        'transition-[translate,opacity] duration-300 ease-[cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1)] motion-reduce:transition-none',
        'data-[starting-style]:opacity-0 data-[ending-style]:opacity-0',
        enterFrom[position],
        // While a finger is down the toast must track it exactly, with no easing.
        'data-[swiping]:transition-none',
        'rounded-surface'
      )}
    >
      <BaseToast.Title className="pr-6 text-sm font-semibold leading-none tracking-[-0.01em]" />
      <BaseToast.Description className="mt-1 text-sm leading-5 text-muted-foreground" />
      <BaseToast.Close
        className="absolute right-2 top-2 inline-flex size-6 cursor-pointer items-center justify-center text-xs leading-none text-muted-foreground transition-colors outline-none hover:text-foreground focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring"
        aria-label="Close"
      >
        ✕
      </BaseToast.Close>
    </BaseToast.Root>
  ));
}
export interface ToasterProps {
  /**
   * Screen corner the stack is anchored to. Also sets the direction toasts travel
   * as they arrive and leave.
   * @default 'bottom-right'
   */
  position?: ToastPosition;
}
export function Toaster({ position = 'bottom-right' }: ToasterProps) {
  return (
    <BaseToast.Portal>
      <BaseToast.Viewport className={viewportVariants({ position })}>
        <ToastList position={position} />
      </BaseToast.Viewport>
    </BaseToast.Portal>
  );
}
export { viewportVariants as toastViewportVariants };
````

````tsx
import { Toggle as BaseToggle } from '@base-ui/react/toggle';
````

## Tooltip (`tooltip`)

Tooltip built on Base UI.

- Type: `registry:ui`
- Install: `npx @ternetin/ui add tooltip`
- npm dependencies: `@base-ui/react@^1.9.0`
- Registry dependencies: `utils`, `motion`

### `src/ui/tooltip.tsx`

````tsx
'use client';
import { Tooltip as BaseTooltip } from '@base-ui/react/tooltip';
import type * as React from 'react';
import { transitions, useMotionPopupRender } from '@/lib/motion';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';

/**
 * Base UI waits 600ms before showing a tooltip. That's long enough that a hover
 * feels like nothing happened, so both the provider and the root default to
 * something snappier here. Pass `delay`/`closeDelay` to override.
 *
 * `closeDelay` is deliberately non-zero: it lets the pointer cross the gap between
 * trigger and popup without the tooltip flickering out.
 */
const OPEN_DELAY = 200;
const CLOSE_DELAY = 100;
export function TooltipProvider({
  delay = OPEN_DELAY,
  closeDelay = CLOSE_DELAY,
  ...props
}: BaseTooltip.Provider.Props) {
  return <BaseTooltip.Provider delay={delay} closeDelay={closeDelay} {...props} />;
}
export const Tooltip = BaseTooltip.Root;
/**
 * Carries the same delay default as {@link TooltipProvider}, so a tooltip used
 * without a provider is just as responsive. A provider, when present, still wins
 * for grouping behaviour.
 */
export function TooltipTrigger({ delay = OPEN_DELAY, ...props }: BaseTooltip.Trigger.Props) {
  return <BaseTooltip.Trigger delay={delay} {...props} />;
}
export function TooltipContent({
  className,
  sideOffset = 8,
  children,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<typeof BaseTooltip.Popup> & {
  sideOffset?: number;
}) {
  // Tooltips are the lightest surface in the library: barely any scale, and a
  // faster curve than the rest, since they follow the pointer around.
  const renderPopup = useMotionPopupRender({
    scale: 0.94,
    offset: 3,
    transition: { duration: transitions.fade.duration, ease: 'easeOut' }
  });
  return (
    <BaseTooltip.Portal>
      <BaseTooltip.Positioner sideOffset={sideOffset} className="z-50">
        <BaseTooltip.Popup
          className={cn(
            'border border-border bg-foreground px-2 py-1 text-xs font-medium leading-none tracking-[-0.01em] text-background',
            '[transform-origin:var(--transform-origin)]',
            'rounded-surface',
            className
          )}
          render={renderPopup}
          {...props}
        >
          {children}
        </BaseTooltip.Popup>
      </BaseTooltip.Positioner>
    </BaseTooltip.Portal>
  );
}
````

## ASCII SVG (`ascii-svg`)

Globs an SVG from its children and renders it as live, animatable ASCII art by rasterizing to a canvas and mapping brightness onto a character ramp.

- Type: `registry:ui`
- Install: `npx @ternetin/ui add ascii-svg`
- npm dependencies: none
- Registry dependencies: `utils`

### `src/ui/ascii-svg.tsx`

````tsx
'use client';
import * as React from 'react';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';
/** Brightness ramps, dark → light. */
export const ASCII_RAMPS = {
  standard: ' .:-=+*#%@',
  dense: ' .\'`^",:;Il!i~+_-?][}{1)(|/tfjrxnuvczXYUJCLQ0OZmwqpdbkhao*#MW&8%B@$',
  minimal: ' .oO@',
  blocks: ' ░▒▓█',
  binary: '01',
  dots: ' ·•●'
} as const;
export interface AsciiSvgProps extends Omit<React.ComponentProps<'pre'>, 'children'> {
  /** The SVG (or any node containing one) to ASCII-fy. Rendered off-screen and sampled. */
  children: React.ReactNode;
  /** Number of character columns. Higher = more detail. */
  cols?: number;
  /** Brightness ramp, dark → light. Pass a string or a key of {@link ASCII_RAMPS}. */
  chars?: string;
  /** CSS selector for the element to sample inside `children`. Defaults to the first `<svg>`. */
  select?: string;
  /** Re-sample every frame — turn on for animated SVGs so the ASCII animates with them. */
  live?: boolean;
  /** Max samples per second when `live`. */
  fps?: number;
  /** Invert the ramp (light shapes on a dark ground). */
  invert?: boolean;
}
/**
 * Globs an SVG out of its children, rasterizes it to an offscreen canvas and maps
 * per-cell brightness onto an ASCII ramp — the classic image-to-ASCII trick, applied
 * live to vector art. The source SVG is rendered off-screen (so the browser lays it
 * out and animates it) and sampled; only the ASCII is shown.
 *
 * CSS-context paint (`currentColor`, `var(--…)`) can't resolve inside an isolated
 * `<img>`, so it's flattened to solid white-on-black before sampling — background/card
 * tokens become the knockout, everything else becomes the shape.
 */
export function AsciiSvg({
  children,
  cols = 44,
  chars = ASCII_RAMPS.standard,
  select = 'svg',
  live = false,
  fps = 24,
  invert = false,
  className,
  ...props
}: AsciiSvgProps) {
  const hostRef = React.useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const [art, setArt] = React.useState('');
  // Reserve the box before first paint with a same-size blank grid, so the ASCII
  // filling in on the first (async) sample doesn't resize the layout and jump.
  const useIsoLayout = typeof window !== 'undefined' ? React.useLayoutEffect : React.useEffect;
  useIsoLayout(() => {
    if (art) return;
    const svg = hostRef.current?.querySelector(select) as SVGSVGElement | null;
    if (!svg) return;
    const rect = svg.getBoundingClientRect();
    const w = rect.width || svg.viewBox?.baseVal?.width || 100;
    const h = rect.height || svg.viewBox?.baseVal?.height || 100;
    const rows = Math.max(1, Math.round(cols * (h / w) * 0.5));
    setArt(Array.from({ length: rows }, () => ' '.repeat(cols)).join('\n'));
    // Placeholder only — run once on mount.
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, []);
  // biome-ignore lint/correctness/useExhaustiveDependencies: children re-runs sampling when the SVG source changes.
  React.useEffect(() => {
    const host = hostRef.current;
    if (!host || typeof window === 'undefined') return;
    let stopped = false;
    let timer = 0;
    const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d', { willReadFrequently: true });
    if (!ctx) return;
    const sample = () =>
      new Promise<void>((resolve) => {
        const svg = host.querySelector(select) as SVGSVGElement | null;
        if (!svg) return resolve();
        const rect = svg.getBoundingClientRect();
        const w = rect.width || svg.viewBox?.baseVal?.width || 100;
        const h = rect.height || svg.viewBox?.baseVal?.height || 100;
        const rows = Math.max(1, Math.round(cols * (h / w) * 0.5)); // 0.5 ≈ char aspect
        let markup = new XMLSerializer().serializeToString(svg);
        markup = markup
          // Theme surfaces read as the knockout (black), so holes stay holes.
          .replace(/var\(\s*--[a-z0-9-]*(?:background|card|popover|muted)[a-z0-9-]*[^)]*\)/gi, '#000000')
          .replace(/currentColor/gi, '#ffffff')
          .replace(/var\([^)]*\)/gi, '#ffffff');
        if (!/<svg[^>]*\swidth=/i.test(markup)) markup = markup.replace('<svg', `<svg width="${w}"`);
        if (!/<svg[^>]*\sheight=/i.test(markup)) markup = markup.replace('<svg', `<svg height="${h}"`);
        const img = new Image();
        const blob = new Blob([markup], { type: 'image/svg+xml' });
        const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
        img.onload = () => {
          const m = 4; // super-sample each cell
          canvas.width = cols * m;
          canvas.height = rows * m;
          ctx.fillStyle = '#000000';
          ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
          ctx.drawImage(img, 0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
          const data = ctx.getImageData(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height).data;
          let out = '';
          for (let y = 0; y < rows; y++) {
            for (let x = 0; x < cols; x++) {
              let sum = 0;
              for (let sy = 0; sy < m; sy++) {
                for (let sx = 0; sx < m; sx++) {
                  const idx = ((y * m + sy) * canvas.width + (x * m + sx)) * 4;
                  sum += (data[idx] + data[idx + 1] + data[idx + 2]) / 3 / 255;
                }
              }
              let b = sum / (m * m);
              if (invert) b = 1 - b;
              out += chars[Math.min(chars.length - 1, Math.floor(b * (chars.length - 1)))];
            }
            out += '\n';
          }
          URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
          if (!stopped) setArt(out);
          resolve();
        };
        img.onerror = () => {
          URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
          resolve();
        };
        img.src = url;
      });
    const loop = async () => {
      if (stopped) return;
      await sample();
      if (!stopped && live) timer = window.setTimeout(loop, 1000 / fps);
    };
    loop();
    return () => {
      stopped = true;
      window.clearTimeout(timer);
    };
  }, [children, cols, chars, select, live, fps, invert]);
  return (
    <>
      {/* Off-screen source: laid out & animated by the browser, sampled each frame. */}
      <div
        ref={hostRef}
        aria-hidden="true"
        style={{ position: 'fixed', left: '-99999px', top: 0, opacity: 0, pointerEvents: 'none' }}
      >
        {children}
      </div>
      <pre
        aria-hidden="true"
        className={cn(
          'whitespace-pre select-none font-mono leading-[0.8] tracking-[0.15em] text-foreground',
          className
        )}
        {...props}
      >
        {art}
      </pre>
    </>
  );
}
````

## Sidebar (`sidebar`)

Composable app-owned navigation links, buttons, and sidebar regions.

- Type: `registry:ui`
- Install: `npx @ternetin/ui add sidebar`
- npm dependencies: none

### `src/ui/sidebar.tsx`

````tsx
import type * as React from 'react';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';

export function Sidebar({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<'aside'>) {
  return <aside className={cn('flex w-56 shrink-0 flex-col border-r border-border bg-card', className)} {...props} />;
}
export function SidebarHeader({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<'div'>) {
  return (
    <div
      className={cn('flex min-h-14 shrink-0 items-center justify-between gap-3 border-b border-border px-4', className)}
      {...props}
    />
  );
}
export function SidebarContent({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<'nav'>) {
  return <nav className={cn('min-h-0 flex-1 space-y-1 overflow-y-auto p-2', className)} {...props} />;
}
export function SidebarFooter({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<'div'>) {
  return (
    <div className={cn('shrink-0 border-t border-border p-4 text-xs text-muted-foreground', className)} {...props} />
  );
}
const itemClass =
  'ui-control flex min-h-9 w-full items-center gap-3 rounded-control px-3 py-2 text-left text-sm transition-colors outline-none hover:bg-muted focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring [&_svg]:size-4 [&_svg]:shrink-0';
export function SidebarLink({ active, className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<'a'> & { active?: boolean }) {
  return (
    <a
      aria-current={active ? 'page' : undefined}
      className={cn(itemClass, active && 'bg-accent font-medium text-accent-foreground', className)}
      {...props}
    />
  );
}
export function SidebarButton({ active, className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<'button'> & { active?: boolean }) {
  return (
    <button
      type="button"
      aria-pressed={active}
      className={cn(itemClass, 'cursor-pointer', active && 'bg-accent font-medium text-accent-foreground', className)}
      {...props}
    />
  );
}
````

## Sidebar Drawer (`sidebar-drawer`)

Accessible controlled mobile navigation with focus restoration.

- Type: `registry:ui`
- Install: `npx @ternetin/ui add sidebar-drawer`
- npm dependencies: `@base-ui/react@^1.9.0`
- Registry dependencies: `utils`

### `src/ui/sidebar-drawer.tsx`

````tsx
'use client';

import { Dialog } from '@base-ui/react/dialog';
import * as React from 'react';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';

export interface SidebarDrawerProps {
  open: boolean;
  onOpenChange: (open: boolean) => void;
  children: React.ReactNode;
  title?: string;
  className?: string;
}

export function SidebarDrawer({ open, onOpenChange, title = 'Navigation', className, children }: SidebarDrawerProps) {
  React.useEffect(() => {
    const media = window.matchMedia('(min-width: 1024px)');
    const closeOnDesktop = () => {
      if (media.matches && open) onOpenChange(false);
    };
    closeOnDesktop();
    media.addEventListener('change', closeOnDesktop);
    return () => media.removeEventListener('change', closeOnDesktop);
  }, [open, onOpenChange]);

  return (
    <Dialog.Root open={open} onOpenChange={onOpenChange}>
      <Dialog.Portal>
        <Dialog.Backdrop className="fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-foreground/40 transition-opacity duration-150 data-[ending-style]:opacity-0 data-[starting-style]:opacity-0 motion-reduce:transition-none" />
        <Dialog.Popup
          className={cn(
            'fixed inset-y-0 left-0 z-50 flex w-72 max-w-[calc(100%-3rem)] flex-col bg-card shadow-modal outline-none transition-transform duration-200 data-[ending-style]:-translate-x-full data-[starting-style]:-translate-x-full motion-reduce:transition-none',
            className
          )}
        >
          <div className="flex h-14 shrink-0 items-center justify-between border-b border-border px-4">
            <Dialog.Title className="text-sm font-semibold">{title}</Dialog.Title>
            <Dialog.Close
              className="ui-control grid size-9 place-items-center rounded-control hover:bg-muted focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring"
              aria-label="Close navigation"
            >
              <svg
                viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                className="size-4"
                fill="none"
                stroke="currentColor"
                strokeWidth="1.75"
                aria-hidden="true"
              >
                <path d="m6 6 12 12M18 6 6 18" />
              </svg>
            </Dialog.Close>
          </div>
          {children}
        </Dialog.Popup>
      </Dialog.Portal>
    </Dialog.Root>
  );
}
````

## Split Pane (`split-pane`)

Controlled responsive list/detail panes with mobile focus management.

- Type: `registry:ui`
- Install: `npx @ternetin/ui add split-pane`
- npm dependencies: none
- Registry dependencies: `utils`

### `src/ui/split-pane.tsx`

````tsx
'use client';

import * as React from 'react';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';

type Pane = 'primary' | 'secondary';

export function SplitPane({
  activePane = 'primary',
  className,
  onFocusCapture,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<'div'> & { activePane?: Pane }) {
  const root = React.useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const previous = React.useRef(activePane);
  const focused = React.useRef<Partial<Record<Pane, HTMLElement>>>({});

  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (previous.current !== activePane && window.matchMedia('(max-width: 1023px)').matches) {
      const panel = root.current?.querySelector<HTMLElement>(`[data-pane="${activePane}"]`);
      const remembered = focused.current[activePane];
      if (remembered?.isConnected && panel?.contains(remembered)) remembered.focus();
      else panel?.focus();
    }
    previous.current = activePane;
  }, [activePane]);

  return (
    <div
      ref={root}
      data-active-pane={activePane}
      onFocusCapture={(event) => {
        const target = event.target;
        const pane = target.closest<HTMLElement>('[data-pane]')?.dataset.pane as Pane | undefined;
        if (pane) focused.current[pane] = target;
        onFocusCapture?.(event);
      }}
      className={cn(
        'group/split grid min-h-0 min-w-0 flex-1 grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-[minmax(18rem,24rem)_minmax(0,1fr)]',
        className
      )}
      {...props}
    />
  );
}

export function SplitPanePrimary({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<'section'>) {
  return (
    <section
      data-pane="primary"
      tabIndex={-1}
      className={cn(
        'flex min-h-0 min-w-0 flex-col border-r border-border outline-none group-data-[active-pane=secondary]/split:hidden lg:group-data-[active-pane=secondary]/split:flex',
        className
      )}
      {...props}
    />
  );
}
export function SplitPaneSecondary({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<'section'>) {
  return (
    <section
      data-pane="secondary"
      tabIndex={-1}
      className={cn(
        'flex min-h-0 min-w-0 flex-col bg-card outline-none group-data-[active-pane=primary]/split:hidden lg:group-data-[active-pane=primary]/split:flex',
        className
      )}
      {...props}
    />
  );
}
````

## Settings Section (`settings-section`)

Consistent settings heading, description, body, and actions.

- Type: `registry:ui`
- Install: `npx @ternetin/ui add settings-section`
- npm dependencies: none
- Registry dependencies: `utils`

### `src/ui/settings-section.tsx`

````tsx
import type * as React from 'react';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';

export function SettingsSection({
  title,
  description,
  actions,
  children,
  headingLevel = 2,
  className,
  ...props
}: Omit<React.ComponentProps<'section'>, 'title'> & {
  title: React.ReactNode;
  description?: React.ReactNode;
  actions?: React.ReactNode;
  headingLevel?: 2 | 3;
}) {
  const Heading = headingLevel === 3 ? 'h3' : 'h2';
  return (
    <section className={cn('space-y-4 border-b border-border py-6 last:border-b-0', className)} {...props}>
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-3">
        <div>
          <Heading className="text-sm font-semibold">{title}</Heading>
          {description && <p className="mt-1 max-w-prose text-sm leading-6 text-muted-foreground">{description}</p>}
        </div>
        {actions}
      </div>
      {children}
    </section>
  );
}
````

## Badge (`badge`)

Text-first semantic status label.

- Type: `registry:ui`
- Install: `npx @ternetin/ui add badge`
- npm dependencies: none
- Registry dependencies: `utils`

### `src/ui/badge.tsx`

````tsx
import type * as React from 'react';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';

const tones = {
  neutral: 'bg-muted text-muted-foreground',
  success: 'bg-success-muted text-success',
  warning: 'bg-warning-muted text-warning',
  danger: 'bg-destructive/10 text-destructive',
  info: 'bg-info-muted text-info'
};
export function Badge({
  tone = 'neutral',
  className,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<'span'> & { tone?: keyof typeof tones }) {
  return (
    <span
      className={cn(
        'inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-control px-2 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium',
        tones[tone],
        className
      )}
      {...props}
    />
  );
}
````

## Alert (`alert`)

Inline informational, success, warning, or error feedback.

- Type: `registry:ui`
- Install: `npx @ternetin/ui add alert`
- npm dependencies: none
- Registry dependencies: `utils`

### `src/ui/alert.tsx`

````tsx
import type * as React from 'react';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';

const tones = {
  info: 'border-info/30 bg-info-muted text-info',
  success: 'border-success/30 bg-success-muted text-success',
  warning: 'border-warning/30 bg-warning-muted text-warning',
  danger: 'border-destructive/30 bg-destructive/5 text-destructive'
};
export function Alert({
  tone = 'info',
  className,
  role,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<'div'> & { tone?: keyof typeof tones }) {
  return (
    <div
      role={role ?? (tone === 'danger' ? 'alert' : undefined)}
      className={cn('rounded-surface border p-4 text-sm leading-6', tones[tone], className)}
      {...props}
    />
  );
}
````

````tsx
/** A complete presentation example. Connect submission to your app's auth flow. */
export function AuthExample() {
  const [submitted, setSubmitted] = React.useState(false);
  return (
    <AuthLayout>
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-sm">
        <a href="/examples" className="font-semibold text-primary underline-offset-4 hover:underline">
          internet-ui
        </a>
        <span className="text-muted-foreground">Authentication example</span>
      </div>

          <CardTitle>Welcome back</CardTitle>
          <CardDescription>Sign in to your workspace.</CardDescription>
        </CardHeader>
        <form
          className="space-y-4"
          onSubmit={(event) => {
            event.preventDefault();
            setSubmitted(true);
          }}
        >
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <label htmlFor="example-email" className="text-sm font-medium">
              Email
            </label>
            <Input
              id="example-email"
              name="email"
              type="email"
              autoComplete="email"
              placeholder="you@example.com"
              required
            />
          </div>
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <label htmlFor="example-password" className="text-sm font-medium">
              Password
            </label>
            <Input id="example-password" name="password" type="password" autoComplete="current-password" required />
          </div>
          <Button type="submit" className="w-full">
            Sign in
          </Button>
          {submitted && (
            <Alert role="status">
              This example does not send credentials. Connect your authentication handler here.
            </Alert>
          )}
        </form>
      </Card>
      <p className="text-center text-xs leading-5 text-muted-foreground">
        Illustrative form. No account is created and no credentials are sent.
      </p>
    </AuthLayout>
  );
}
````

## Admin Example (`admin-example`)

Complete metrics and filterable table page with fictional data.

- Type: `registry:block`
- Install: `npx @ternetin/ui add admin-example`
- npm dependencies: none
- Registry dependencies: `badge`, `button`, `card`, `data-table`, `page-layout`, `stat`

### `src/ui/admin-example.tsx`

````tsx
'use client';

import type { ColumnDef } from '@tanstack/react-table';
import { Badge } from '@/ui/badge';
import { Button } from '@/ui/button';
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle } from '@/ui/card';
import { DataTable } from '@/ui/data-table';
import { PageActions, PageContainer, PageDescription, PageHeader, PageTitle } from '@/ui/page-layout';
import { Stat } from '@/ui/stat';

const services = [
  { name: 'docs', endpoint: 'docs.example.com', status: 'Connected', requests: 1248 },
  { name: 'preview', endpoint: 'preview.example.com', status: 'Connected', requests: 326 },
  { name: 'development', endpoint: 'dev.example.com', status: 'Offline', requests: 0 },
  { name: 'webhook', endpoint: 'hooks.example.com', status: 'Connected', requests: 87 }
];
const columns: ColumnDef<(typeof services)[number]>[] = [
  {
    accessorKey: 'name',
    header: 'Service',
    cell: ({ row }) => (
      <div>
        <span className="font-medium">{row.original.name}</span>
        <p className="mt-0.5 text-xs text-muted-foreground">{row.original.endpoint}</p>
      </div>
    )
  },
  {
    accessorKey: 'status',
    header: 'Status',
    cell: ({ row }) => (
      <Badge tone={row.original.status === 'Connected' ? 'success' : 'neutral'}>{row.original.status}</Badge>
    )
  },
  {
    accessorKey: 'requests',
    header: 'Requests',
    cell: ({ row }) => <span className="tabular-nums">{row.original.requests.toLocaleString('en')}</span>
  }
];

/** Fictional fixture data; no service or account requests are made. */
export function AdminExample() {
  return (
    <PageContainer>
      <PageHeader>
        <div>
          <PageTitle>Services</PageTitle>
          <PageDescription>
            A compact admin layout with shared metrics, status labels, and a searchable table.
          </PageDescription>
        </div>
        <PageActions>
          <Button variant="outline" render={<a href="/examples" />}>
            All examples
          </Button>
        </PageActions>
      </PageHeader>
      <div className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-3">
        <Stat label="Services" value={4} />
        <Stat label="Connected" value={3} />
        <Stat label="Requests" value="1,661" hint="Fictional example data" />
      </div>
      <Card padding="none">
        <CardHeader className="border-b border-border p-5">
          <CardTitle>Service directory</CardTitle>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent className="p-4">
          <DataTable
            columns={columns}
            data={services}
            getRowId={(service) => service.name}
            enableRowSelection={false}
            initialPageSize={5}
            pageSizeOptions={[5, 10, 20]}
            searchPlaceholder="Find a service"
            emptyMessage="No services match your search."
          />
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    </PageContainer>
  );
}
````

## Workspace Example (`workspace-example`)

Complete responsive sidebar/list/detail workspace with fictional messages.

- Type: `registry:block`
- Install: `npx @ternetin/ui add workspace-example`
- npm dependencies: none
- Registry dependencies: `app-shell`, `button`, `empty-state`, `input`, `sidebar`, `sidebar-drawer`, `split-pane`

### `src/ui/workspace-example.tsx`

````tsx
'use client';

import * as React from 'react';
import { AppBody, AppHeader, AppMain, AppShell } from '@/ui/app-shell';
import { Button } from '@/ui/button';
import { EmptyState } from '@/ui/empty-state';
import { Input } from '@/ui/input';
import { Sidebar, SidebarButton, SidebarContent, SidebarFooter, SidebarHeader } from '@/ui/sidebar';
import { SidebarDrawer } from '@/ui/sidebar-drawer';
import { SplitPane, SplitPanePrimary, SplitPaneSecondary } from '@/ui/split-pane';

const messages = [
  {
    id: 'release',
    sender: 'Release notes',
    subject: 'Your workspace is ready',
    text: 'This is a complete responsive layout example. The sidebar, list, and detail pane are composed from independent components.'
  },
  {
    id: 'welcome',
    sender: 'Example team',
    subject: 'A quieter place to work',
    text: 'Select a message on a narrow screen, then use Back to return to the list. Keyboard focus returns to the item you selected.'
  },
  {
    id: 'review',
    sender: 'Design review',
    subject: 'Shared foundations',
    text: 'Consistent typography, borders, corners, and spacing let the content lead. This example contains fictional data only.'
  }
];

export function WorkspaceExample() {
  const [selected, setSelected] = React.useState<string | null>(null);
  const [folder, setFolder] = React.useState('Inbox');
  const [navigationOpen, setNavigationOpen] = React.useState(false);
  const [search, setSearch] = React.useState('');
  const detail = messages.find((message) => message.id === selected);
  const filtered =
    folder === 'Inbox'
      ? messages.filter((message) =>
          `${message.sender} ${message.subject}`.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase())
        )
      : [];
  const navigation = (
    <>
      <SidebarContent aria-label="Example folders">
        {['Inbox', 'Archive', 'Trash'].map((name) => (
          <SidebarButton
            key={name}
            active={folder === name}
            onClick={() => {
              setFolder(name);
              setSelected(null);
              setNavigationOpen(false);
            }}
          >
            {name}
          </SidebarButton>
        ))}
      </SidebarContent>
      <SidebarFooter>Fictional example data</SidebarFooter>
    </>
  );

  return (
    <AppShell>
      <AppHeader>
        <Button
          variant="ghost"
          size="icon"
          aria-label="Open navigation"
          className="lg:hidden"
          onClick={() => setNavigationOpen(true)}
        >
          <svg
            viewBox="0 0 24 24"
            className="size-4"
            fill="none"
            stroke="currentColor"
            strokeWidth="1.75"
            aria-hidden="true"
          >
            <path d="M4 6h16M4 12h16M4 18h16" />
          </svg>
        </Button>
        <span className="font-semibold">Workspace example</span>
        <a className="ml-auto text-sm text-primary hover:underline" href="/examples">
          All examples
        </a>
      </AppHeader>
      <AppBody>
        <Sidebar className="hidden lg:flex">
          <SidebarHeader>
            <span className="font-medium">Folders</span>
          </SidebarHeader>
          {navigation}
        </Sidebar>
        <SidebarDrawer open={navigationOpen} onOpenChange={setNavigationOpen} title="Folders">
          {navigation}
        </SidebarDrawer>
        <AppMain className="flex overflow-hidden">
          <SplitPane activePane={selected ? 'secondary' : 'primary'}>
            <SplitPanePrimary aria-label="Message list">
              <div className="space-y-3 border-b border-border p-4">
                <h1 className="text-base font-semibold">{folder}</h1>
                <Input
                  aria-label="Search messages"
                  type="search"
                  placeholder="Search messages"
                  value={search}
                  onChange={(event) => setSearch(event.target.value)}
                />
              </div>
              <div className="min-h-0 flex-1 overflow-y-auto">
                {filtered.length ? (
                  filtered.map((message) => (
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      key={message.id}
                      onClick={() => setSelected(message.id)}
                      className={`flex w-full cursor-pointer flex-col gap-1 border-b border-border p-4 text-left outline-none hover:bg-muted focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-inset focus-visible:ring-ring ${selected === message.id ? 'bg-accent' : ''}`}
                    >
                      <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{message.sender}</span>
                      <span className="font-medium">{message.subject}</span>
                      <span className="line-clamp-2 text-xs leading-5 text-muted-foreground">{message.text}</span>
                    </button>
                  ))
                ) : (
                  <EmptyState
                    title={search ? 'No matches' : 'Folder is empty'}
                    description={search ? 'Try another search term.' : 'Choose Inbox to explore the example messages.'}
                  />
                )}
              </div>
            </SplitPanePrimary>
            <SplitPaneSecondary aria-label="Message detail">
              {detail ? (
                <>
                  <div className="flex min-h-14 items-center border-b border-border px-4">
                    <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" className="lg:hidden" onClick={() => setSelected(null)}>
                      Back to messages
                    </Button>
                    <span className="hidden text-xs text-muted-foreground lg:inline">Illustrative message</span>
                  </div>
                  <article className="min-h-0 flex-1 space-y-4 overflow-y-auto p-5 sm:p-8">
                    <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{detail.sender}</p>
                    <h2 className="text-xl font-semibold">{detail.subject}</h2>
                    <p className="max-w-prose text-sm leading-7">{detail.text}</p>
                  </article>
                </>
              ) : (
                <EmptyState
                  className="flex-1"
                  title="Select a message"
                  description="Choose a message from the list to read it here."
                />
              )}
            </SplitPaneSecondary>
          </SplitPane>
        </AppMain>
      </AppBody>
    </AppShell>
  );
}
````
